senses.gloss: m. (denom. of בֵּיר or בּוֹר, cmp. בּוּר Pi. 2) superintendent of the well in rural communities.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 8:5">Shebi. VIII, 5</cite> <he>אין נותנין לא לב׳ וכ׳</he> (out of the money realized from the fruits of the Sabbath year) you must not pay the well-master &c.; <he>אבל נותן הוא לב׳ לשתות</he> but you may pay the well-master a fee for giving you water to drink.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:14">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 14</cite> <he>הב׳ והבלן וכ׳</he> (Y.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:14">ib.</cite> beg. 12ᵃ ed. Krot. <cite ref="E00377"><he>הכ׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.) the well-master, the bather &c. when collecting their fees from the owner (individually), may attach only the owner’s share in the produces. Ib. VIII, 11ᵈ top <he>שאלה מן הב׳</he>; [Bab. ib. 97ᵇ <he>למישאל מידי מחבריה</he>, read <he>מבַּיָּירָא</he> ch.].
